limits: Current complete selection replays do not reconstruct historical registry snapshots.
The full DF capture includes a preflight hits outside the public request flow; the replay serves the next two independently captured hits for the API warning and acquisition checks.

Historical GO and RS pages contain duplicated property versions but do not contain every page of those selections. Their all-cell/version oracles exercise the parser only, with original numberMatched retained.
Current GO/RS complete queries no longer contain those duplicated versions; no cause is inferred.
No geometry N2, no cache in this API, no N3 between pages, dates or UFs.
Source MetaInfo currently lacks raw page hashes/sizes; acquisition receipts and the replay manifest retain them. fetch_timestamp convention is left for the cross-cutting RG review.
A single dataset route uses attempted_sources=['sicar'] and selected_source='sicar'; the direct source uses ['sicar_wfs'] and 'sicar_wfs'. Both retain source_details['sicar'].
The HTTP replay checks signatures and occurrence selectors and verifies response consumption, not global request ordering; the two DF hits publish the same count.
